_comment: Copy this file to pst.config.json to use it. Everything here is optional.
You only need it if the tool cannot work out your export's columns on its
own, which it will tell you if it happens. Run with --show-columns to see
_columns_comment: Map a field the tool needs onto the exact heading in your CSV.
Left side: the tool's field name. Right side: your column heading.
Fields: number, date, customer, subtotal, total, pst, gst, tax_total,
_date_order_comment: Only needed if your dates are numeric like 03/07/2026 AND the tool cannot
tell which way round they are. 'dmy' = 3 July. 'mdy' = 7 March.
Leave this out and the tool will work it out from the whole column.
